topic: Data staging and cluster setup clarification
summary_markdown:
The conversation focused on clarifying data sources and development environments. It was confirmed that the dataset is considered 'PROD on STAGE' (i.e., PROD data viewed in a staging environment). A new, separate dedicated DEV cluster will be set up for future development work.

Regarding analytics viewing, it was noted that the dashboard on the STAGE environment is more accurate due to a fix implemented for timezone shift granularity at the day level.
decisions: The dataset used is considered 'PROD on STAGE'.
A new, separate DEV cluster will be established for development work.
